# Upstream and local adaptation

Source: https://github.com/nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill at commit `3a13158ff1f32156cbe144108de48eda2ecaed9a`. License: MIT; see `UPSTREAM-LICENSE.txt`.

AgentKit adapts the search command to resolve the installed skill directory. Its source content policy excludes selected platform names and catalog entries. The installed font and icon catalogs are therefore local subsets of the upstream catalogs, with refreshed counts and hashes in `data/catalog-summary.json` and an explicit note in `data/data-provenance.json`. The upstream development tests are omitted from the installed skill.
